entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, Joker, there's some kinda vent over[n]here too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Might as well take the playin' card with us!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That decoration seems similar to where[n]we found the vent earlier...
entries.uk: Ця оздоба схожа на ту, біля якої[n]ми раніше знайшли вентиляцію...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's difficult to know if they are related,[n]but perhaps we should examine it and[n]find out.
entries.uk: Важко сказати, чи вони пов'язані,[n]але, мабуть, варто її оглянути[n]й з'ясувати.
